headline: Exploring physics through research, computation and communication.
biography: A scientific high school student based in Sassuolo, Italy, with experience in quantum physics research, peer tutoring and student representation. Academic interests include numerical modelling, scientific computing and the foundations of physical theories.

education.title: Scientific high school diploma — expected June 2027
Dual Diploma programme
education.description: U.S. high school diploma completed alongside the Italian scientific curriculum.

experience.title: Physics research intern
experience.description: Academic research placement with Prof. Valentina De Renzi, exploring quantum mechanics, Heisenberg’s uncertainty principle, qubit dynamics and quantum computing architectures.

experience.title: Student body president
experience.description: Elected student representative on institutional boards, coordinating school-wide academic and cultural initiatives.

experience.title: Physics and mathematics peer tutor
experience.description: Selected by faculty for academic merit to support younger students through the school’s STEM help desk.

experience.title: STEM content creator
experience.description: Developing educational video modules on differential equations, numerical modelling and scientific computing with Python and PyTorch.
